array_semantics.command_argv_arrays: preserve exact original argument order; never sort
array_semantics.identifier_set_arrays: sort ascending by exact UTF-8 bytes; duplicate values forbidden

canonical_json_string_serialization.canonical_hash_target: SHA-256 is computed over the complete canonical UTF-8 JSON artifact bytes after all values and member names have been serialized by these rules.
canonical_json_string_serialization.control_character_rule: Every U+0000 through U+001F character MUST be emitted using exactly six ASCII bytes: reverse solidus, lowercase 'u', and four lowercase hexadecimal digits. Short escapes such as \b, \t, \n, \f, and \r are forbidden in canonical output.
canonical_json_string_serialization.input_semantics: Canonicalization operates on the parsed Unicode scalar-value sequence after JSON escape decoding. Original source escape spelling is not retained.
canonical_json_string_serialization.member_name_rule: JSON object member names use this exact same string-emission algorithm.
canonical_json_string_serialization.member_sort_key_rule: Object members are sorted before escaping by ascending lexicographic order of the exact UTF-8 encoding of the parsed member-name Unicode scalar-value sequence.
canonical_json_string_serialization.non_ascii_rule: Every valid Unicode scalar value above U+001F other than U+0022 and U+005C MUST be emitted directly using its shortest well-formed UTF-8 encoding. A \uXXXX or surrogate-pair escape for such a value is forbidden in canonical output.
canonical_json_string_serialization.quotation_mark_rule: U+0022 MUST be emitted as exactly two ASCII bytes 5C 22 (reverse solidus followed by quotation mark).
canonical_json_string_serialization.reverse_solidus_rule: U+005C MUST be emitted as exactly two ASCII bytes 5C 5C.
canonical_json_string_serialization.semantic_escape_equivalence_rule: Different valid JSON source spellings that decode to the same Unicode scalar-value sequence MUST produce identical canonical UTF-8 bytes.
canonical_json_string_serialization.solidus_rule: U+002F MUST be emitted unescaped as ASCII byte 2F.
canonical_json_string_serialization.unicode_scalar_requirement: Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code points U+D800 through U+DFFF are invalid input and MUST be rejected.

hash_self_reference_rule.hash_binding_location: a different provenance/checksum artifact or a checksum-bound verifier-output record
hash_self_reference_rule.hash_target: complete canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes of the artifact; the artifact contains no in-band self-hash field

numeric_canonicalization.integer_text: base-10 shortest representation; '-' allowed only for negative values

scope: future AEA01-AEA05 accounting evidence artifacts and associated freeze/verifier evidence only

string_canonicalization.comparison: exact Unicode scalar-value sequence; no trimming and no case folding
string_canonicalization.identifier_set_array_order: ascending lexicographic order of exact UTF-8 byte sequences
string_canonicalization.object_member_order: ascending lexicographic order of exact UTF-8 byte sequences of member names
